summary: This directory contains the test suite and testing infrastructure responsible for verifying the core code analysis functionality. It ensures that the analysis logic correctly interprets and processes various source code constructs and project configurations.
responsibilities: Verify the accuracy of code analysis for different programming constructs.
Validate the parsing and interpretation of project files and configurations.
Provide testing utilities for setting up mock project environments.
Ensure consistent behavior across different input types including classes, functions, and interfaces.
relationships: Test fixtures provide controlled environments to evaluate how the analysis engine processes specific code constructs.
The analysis tests rely on the project context initialization to verify that code analysis yields expected results.
designDecisions: Isolated test cases for granular verification of specific language elements.
Centralized fixture creation to simulate realistic project structures for validation.
Integration testing approach to verify end-to-end analysis of files and packages.
